description: Unmute a built-in publication previously muted with disable_global_source, so its Stories return to this account’s feed. Pass the same exact name; list_sources shows the muted ones. Custom RSS feeds are resumed with toggle_source instead. Idempotent: unmuting a publication that is not muted changes nothing.

source_name.description: Exact name of the global source to re-enable.

name: enable_global_source
